paper_title: VisuoThink Empowering LVLM Reasoning with Multimodal Tree Search
caption: The performance gain (+%) on tasks through predictive rollout search. The performance gain is calculated via the performance gap between VisuoThink (w/o rollout search) and VisuoThink.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance gain, measured as a percentage increase, for various models under strong and weak supervision conditions. The horizontal axis lists four model names: GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL. The vertical axis represents the performance gain as a percentage, labeled "Performance Gain (+%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30 in increments of 5. The chart features two colors: a diagonal striped pattern for strong supervision and a solid fill for weak supervision. The strong supervision bars have approximate values of 24 for GPT-4o, 10 for Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and 14 for Qwen2-72B-VL, while the weak supervision bars have approximate values of 5 for GPT-4o, 3 for Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and 5 for Qwen2-72B-VL. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation.
